    • relocate

      public void relocate(File input, File output, String pattern, String relocated) throws Throwable
      Relocate a jar file including paths and imports and put the changes into an output file.
      If output file does not exist, it will be created.
      Parameters:
      input - Input file to relocate.
      output - Output file to put all the changes.
      pattern - Path to relocate.
      relocated - Relocated path.
      Throws:
      Throwable - If any error occurs on reflected method invoking.

    • relocate

      public void relocate(File input, File output, Map<String,String> relocations) throws Throwable
      Relocate a jar file including paths and imports and put the changes into an output file.
      If output file does not exist, it will be created.
      Parameters:
      input - Input file to relocate.
      output - Output file to put all the changes.
      relocations - A map containing all the paths you want to relocate.
      Throws:
      Throwable - If any error occurs on reflected method invoking.
